independent.summary: Opting the search into the envelope adds a second full scan per keystroke-word: the unpaged path returned before any count, but the paged path runs `countDocuments(filter)` with the keyword `$or` (an unindexable regex over title/summary/`blocks.data.markdown`) in addition to the limited `find`, so each 250ms-debounced search now costs two workspace-wide scans instead of one — the event-loop serialization is fixed, the per-search DB work roughly doubles.

The test named 'asks for no more than the route will serve' only asserts `SEARCH_RESULT_LIMIT === 200` against a hardcoded literal, with no link to the server's `LIST_LIMIT_MAX`; if the route's cap were lowered the client would silently over-ask and this test would still pass, so it does not test the cross-boundary claim in its name.

Correct: nothing release-gated changes — `readAnswer` keeps the bare-array path so client and API can deploy independently without coordination.
